title: 원래 해상도 backbone의 폭·깊이 확대
hypothesis: Shrinking the W2 branch lowered RR (74, 75), and widening/deepening it reduced the 4-8 px error that varies between seeds (75: 64x8 -> 128x8 removed 9% of the 4-8 px uncorrelated component). The full-resolution backbone (64 channels x 4 blocks, 0.30M) has never been enlarged together with the W2 branch, and in 29 a full-resolution 64x8 branch (W3, about 0.59M) gave +0.643 dB over the original with a quarter of the W2 parameters (+0.723 dB). If capacity at full resolution, where the 2-8 px detail that carries the C2MS gain lives, is still a limit, enlarging the backbone improves RR over 53 C2MS: E1 (backbone 128x8 + W2 128x8, 4.94M), E2 (backbone 64x8 + W2 128x8, 3.15M); E3 (backbone 64x8 + W2 64x8, 1.35M) shows whether moving capacity from W2 to the full-resolution path keeps the C2MS result with half the parameters.

evidence.experiment_29: full-resolution 64x8 branch W3 +0.643 dB vs W2 128x8 +0.723 dB over the original (seed 42, before scale-mixed training)
evidence.experiment_74_75: W2 64x4 -0.521 dB, 128x4 -0.201 dB, 64x8 -0.127 dB against 53 C2MS; depth kept more of the gain than width
evidence.experiment_75_76_seed_variance: 3-seed C2MS average cut the 4-8 px uncorrelated component by 9.8% (+0.28 dB over the member mean); the quarter-resolution branch of 76 cut it by 0%
evidence.experiment_76: C2MS + W4 RR +0.025 dB (noise level); W4 reduced only the 8-16 px error

arms.C2MS_B128D8: backbone x + 1x1 64->128 -> 8 residual blocks at 128 channels (full resolution) -> 1x1 128->64, replacing the original 4 blocks; W2 128x8 as C2MS
arms.C2MS_B64D8: backbone = original 4 blocks + 4 more 64-channel blocks (last conv zero init); W2 128x8 as C2MS
arms.C2MS_B64D8_W64D8: backbone = original 4 blocks + 4 more 64-channel blocks (last conv zero init); W2 64x8 as 75 C2MS_W64D8

comparisons.official: each arm against the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed (criteria v2.4, RR only)
comparisons.run_to_run: each arm against the 57 retrained C2MS (reference)
comparisons.retention: share of the C2MS RR PSNR gain over the original 43 C0; E3 read with 75 C2MS_W64D8 (W2 64x8 with the original backbone)
comparisons.mechanism: frequency/structure split as in 75/76 (4-8 px uncorrelated component, flat regions) against 53 C2MS; reported, not a judgement

control_policy: No new control run: the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed is the official control and the 57 retrained C2MS shows run-to-run variation.

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.4: RR PSNR, SAM, ERGAS against the same-seed 53 C2MS; single seed noise threshold 0.06 dB; FR QNR/D_lambda/D_s reference only
judgement.reported: validation PSNR/SAM per epoch, RR against 53, 57 and the original, share of the C2MS gain kept, FR QNR reference, epoch time of two concurrent trainings

stages.1_screen: QB seed 42, three arms, at most two trainings at the same time (E1 with E3 first, then E2)
stages.reading: E1/E2 are candidates for improving C2MS; E3 asks whether full-resolution capacity is a cheaper use of parameters than W2 capacity
stages.next: seeds 43/44 or GF2/WV3 only after user approval

limits: E1 replaces the original blocks, so its initial output is not the original SSA-MRN output; E2/E3 start exactly from it
the full-resolution 128-channel backbone has about four times the convolution cost of the W2 branch; step time is measured in the preflight benchmark
larger models may raise validation without raising test on QB (seen in 59 and 73)
two trainings share the GPU; cudnn benchmark may pick different algorithms under load, which can change floating-point details but not the training recipe
expected_duration: about 8-10 h for the three arms with two at a time; the preflight benchmark gives the step times
precision: FP16 AMP core training with GradScaler; FP32 transforms, loss, validation and evaluation (as 53/63)
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0, earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as 53/63)
